sentences.en: The person I've chosen to talk about is the French writer Victor Hugo many people have heard of him because his novel, Les Misérables, which he wrote in 1862, is famous around the world.
sentences.zh: 我选择介绍的人物是法国作家维克多·雨果，许多人听说过他，因为他在1862年创作的小说《悲惨世界》举世闻名。

sentences.en: It became a stage musical in the 1980s, and a film version was also released in 2012.
sentences.zh: 这部小说于20世纪80年代被改编为舞台音乐剧，2012年还推出了电影版。

sentences.en: So, some of us.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们中的一些人。

sentences.en: I'm sure. have a pretty general idea of the plot, but we know much less about the author.
sentences.zh: 我确信，对故事情节已有相当普遍的了解，但对作者本人却知之甚少。

sentences.en: Today, I'm going to provide little more insight into this talented man and I'm going to talk particularly about the home he had on the island of Guernsey in the British Channel Islands.
sentences.zh: 今天，我将为大家进一步揭示这位才华横溢的作家，并特别介绍他位于英国海峡群岛根西岛上的住所。

sentences.en: Audioscripts But first, his early career ... as I've said, he was a writer, he was at the height of his career in Paris and he was very highly regarded by his colleagues.
sentences.zh: 听力原文：但首先，简要回顾他的早期职业生涯……正如我之前所说，他是一位作家，在巴黎时正值其创作生涯的巅峰期，且深受同行高度推崇。

sentences.en: As far as literature was concerned, he was the leading figure of the Romantic movement.
sentences.zh: 就文学而言，他是浪漫主义运动的领军人物。

sentences.en: However, as well as being a literary genius, he also gave many speeches about issues like the level of poverty in his society.
sentences.zh: 然而，除了是一位文学天才之外，他还就社会贫困程度等问题发表过大量演讲。

sentences.en: He felt very strongly about this and about other areas where change was needed, like education.
sentences.zh: 他对这一问题以及教育等其他亟需改革的领域抱有强烈信念。

sentences.en: This kind of outspoken criticism was not well liked by the rulers of France and, eventually, the emperor - Napoleon Ill - told Victor Hugo to leave Paris and not return; in other words, he sent him into exile.
sentences.zh: 这种直言不讳的批评并不受法国统治者欢迎，最终，皇帝拿破仑三世命令维克多·雨果离开巴黎且不得返回；换言之，将他流放。

sentences.en: So Victor Hugo was forced to reside in other parts of Europe.
sentences.zh: 因此，维克多·雨果被迫居住在欧洲其他地区。

sentences.en: Guernsey was actually his third place of exile and he landed there in 1855.
sentences.zh: 根西岛实际上是他第三处流放地，他于1855年抵达该岛。

sentences.en: He produced a lot while on Guernsey - including Les Misérables - and to do this, he had to a spend a great deal of time in the home that he had there.
sentences.zh: 他在根西岛期间创作颇丰——包括《悲惨世界》——而为了完成这些作品，他不得不花费大量时间待在自己于当地购置的住宅中。

sentences.en: This was a property that he bought using the money he'd made in France from the publication of a collection of his poetry.
sentences.zh: 这处房产是他用在法国出版诗集所得收入购买的。

sentences.en: It was the only property he ever owned, and he was very proud of it.
sentences.zh: 这是他一生中唯一拥有的房产，他为此深感自豪。

sentences.en: The property Victor Hugo bought on Guernsey was a large, five-storey house in the capital town of St Peter Port and he lived there for 15 years, returning to France in 1870 when Napoleon's Empire collapsed.
sentences.zh: 维克多·雨果在根西岛购置的房产是一座五层高的大型住宅，位于首府圣彼得港，他在此居住了十五年，直至1870年拿破仑帝国垮台后才返回法国。

sentences.en: He decorated and furnished each level, or floor, of the house in unique and wonderful ways, and many people consider the inside of the house to be a 'work of art'.
sentences.zh: 他以独特而精妙的方式装饰并布置了住宅的每一层（即每一楼层），许多人认为这座住宅内部堪称一件‘艺术品’。

sentences.en: Today it's a museum that attracts 200,000 visitors a year.
sentences.zh: 如今，这里已成为一座博物馆，每年吸引二十万游客参观。

sentences.en: He lived in the house with his family ... and portraits of its members still hang in rooms on the ground floor, along with drawings that he did during his travels that he felt were important to him. in other ground-floor rooms, there are huge tapestries that he would have designed and loved.
sentences.zh: 他与家人一同居住在这座房子里……家人的肖像画至今仍悬挂在底层各房间内，旁边还陈列着他旅行途中所绘、且自认为意义重大的素描作品。在其他底层房间中，则悬挂着大幅挂毯，这些挂毯均由他亲自设计并深爱有加。

sentences.en: The walls are covered in dark wood panelling that Victor Hugo created himself using.
sentences.zh: 墙壁覆盖着维克多·雨果亲手制作的深色木制护墙板。

sentences.en: wooden furniture that he bought in the market.
sentences.zh: 所用木材来自他在市场上购得的木质家具。

sentences.en: The items were relatively inexpensive, and he used them to create intricate carvings.
sentences.zh: 这些物品价格相对低廉，他却用它们雕刻出繁复精美的图案。

sentences.en: They gave an atmosphere on the lower level that was shadowy and rather solemn.
sentences.zh: 它们营造出一种幽暗而庄重的底层氛围。

sentences.en: On the next level of the house there are two impressive lounges, where he entertained his guests.
sentences.zh: 住宅的下一层设有两间令人印象深刻的客厅，他常在此款待宾客。

sentences.en: One lounge has entirely red furnishings, such as sofas and wall coverings, and the other blue.
sentences.zh: 其中一间客厅的全部陈设均为红色，例如沙发和墙面装饰；另一间则全为蓝色。

sentences.en: There's a strong Chinese influence in these areas in things like the wallpaper pattern and the lamps - which he would have made himself by copying original versions.
sentences.zh: 这些区域明显受到中国风影响，体现在壁纸图案及灯具等方面——这些灯具均系他仿照原版自行制作。

sentences.en: His library, where he left many of his favourite books, forms the hallway to the third floor and was a comfortable area where he could relax and enjoy his afternoons.
sentences.zh: 他的藏书室——其中存放着他众多心爱的书籍——构成了通往三楼的走廊，是一处舒适惬意的空间，供他放松身心、享受午后时光。

sentences.en: And then, at the very top of the house, there's a room called the Lookout - called that because it looks out over the harbour.
sentences.zh: 最后，在住宅最顶层，有一间名为‘瞭望室’的房间——得名于其可俯瞰港口的视野。

sentences.en: In contrast to the rather dark lower levels, it's full of light and was like a glass office where he would write until lunchtime - often at his desk.
sentences.zh: 与略显阴暗的低层形成鲜明对比，这里光线充足，宛如一间玻璃办公室，他常在此伏案写作直至午餐时间。

sentences.en: So, Victor Hugo was a man of many talents, but he was also true to his values.
sentences.zh: 因此，维克多·雨果不仅才华横溢，更始终坚守自己的价值观。

sentences.en: While living in his house on Guernsey, he entertained many other famous writers, but he also invited a large group of local children from the deprived areas of the island to dinner once a week.
sentences.zh: 居住在根西岛住宅期间，他不仅热情接待了许多其他著名作家，还每周邀请一批来自该岛贫困地区的本地儿童共进晚餐。

sentences.en: What's more, he served them their food, which was an extraordinary gesture for the time period.
sentences.zh: 更值得一提的是，他亲自为孩子们端上食物——这在当时实属非凡之举。

sentences.en: In 1927, the house was owned by his relatives. and they decided to donate it to the city of Paris.
sentences.zh: 1927年，该住宅由其亲属所有，他们决定将其捐赠给巴黎市政府。

sentences.en: It has since been restored using photographs from the period and, as I mentioned earlier, is now a museum that is open to the public.
sentences.zh: 此后，人们依据当时的照片对该建筑进行了修复，如前所述，如今它已作为向公众开放的博物馆。
